selection_invariance: The mislabeled force and energy columns were each robust-standardized independently before farthest-point selection and shard balancing. A positive constant rescaling leaves those standardized columns, the selected indices, and the A/B split unchanged apart from roundoff; no DFT value is used to change the frozen set.
required_evaluation_behavior: Keep the original freeze manifest and shard NPZ hashes unchanged. Convert only the saved MLIP force and energy values during official R1 evaluation, and retain the raw Ry-valued arrays in the merged artifact.
